changes.why: The control board's standard holds a day when more than a tenth of a WAF's applications fail. The band of 0 to 15% was looser than that: a tenth, from Monday

note.saw: A WAF fails 2 to 4% of its applications on a usual day, and the band let up to 15% pass
note.chose: Hold the day when more than a tenth fail, as the board's standard says
note.turnedDown: Keeping 15%: a WAF could fail one application in seven before anyone was asked
note.expect: No hold in a usual quarter

changes.why: The control board added a software bill of materials for every application we host: the catalogue lists it from today, before any tool reports on it, and the feed it will be evidenced by is described ahead

note.saw: The GRC tool's catalogue listed a fifteenth control this morning, and the posture product stopped at the gate
note.chose: Declare it from today, with the weight the board gave it
note.turnedDown: Publishing without it: the board wants its missing evidence counted from the first day
note.expect: Coverage falls by about eight points until a feed is built. The score stays where it is
